status: authored procedurally (GVHMR/Mixamo path unavailable on this machine)
note: The mixamo-llm-mocap pipeline requires a video plate, a GVHMR venv with ~5.3 GB of checkpoints and the license-gated SMPL-X body model, plus a Mixamo FBX/account. None are present; these timings are authored, not measured from footage.

verbs.cancel: none through frame 20; recovery may be cancelled into walk from frame 30
verbs.resource_cost: 1 stamina (engine-side; animation has no cost channel)
verbs.contact_shape: sword arc, right hand over shoulder to across chest, reach ~0.9 m
verbs.contact_rule: resolve once on frame 14-19 against targets inside the arc and facing; direction + range + phase required
verbs.outcome: damage + posture hit; target plays hit, lethal target plays death
verbs.root_motion: 0.20 m forward on frames 12-20, held through recovery
verbs.feedback: blade trail on 12-20, impact spark on resolved contact, camera shake 2 frames on hit
verbs.readability: windup shows the blade behind the shoulder for 12 frames at 320x240 CCTV scale

verbs.cancel: none before frame 18; stagger-lock ends at frame 30
verbs.contact_rule: driven by the resolved sword-slash contact event, never by animation overlap

verbs.end_pose: laid out on the back, feet forward, ragdoll takes over at frame 54

verbs.root_motion: on root only; feet planted in world space during stance

deterministic_tests: startup too early: contact before frame 12 is rejected
late contact: contact after frame 20 is rejected
wrong direction: target outside the arc is rejected
out of range: target beyond 0.9 m is rejected
multiple targets: arc applies the contact once per stable target id
interrupted: hit during windup cancels the attack and plays hit
death: lethal contact on a hit plays death and ends at the ragdoll-ready pose
cooldown: second slash before 0.2 s is rejected
pause and frame step: frame-stepping 0-42 reproduces the same contact windows
loops: idle and all eight walks close within the manifest seam thresholds
